Initial release of greenhelix-agent-ready-commerce.

- Comprehensive guide for retrofitting APIs and storefronts for AI shopping agents.
- Covers structured product feeds, UCP/ACP/x402 payment rails, and GreenHelix marketplace integration.
- Includes production-ready Python code examples and validation steps.
- Provides a 14-day sprint plan for deploying an agent-discoverable storefront.
- Targets brands and developers aiming to increase AI-attributed commerce revenue.
